blocks.text: More Filipino workers will have greater access to quality homes at more affordable prices as Pag-IBIG Fund expands its housing partnerships under President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr.’s Expanded Pambansang Pabahay para sa Pilipino Program, with Filinvest Land Inc. joining its network of partner developers. The partnership opens select Filinvest residential projects to Pag-IBIG Housing Loan financing and allows qualified members to access preferential pricing and other benefits, further widening the housing choices available to Pag-IBIG members.
